We work with reputed clients in Energy, Civil Construction & Infrastructure, and Industry. Head Energy has more than 900 employees, and offices in Bergen, Stavanger, Oslo, Trondheim, Gothenburg, Stenungsund, Esbjerg, Odense, and Hamburg. We are employee owned, client focused and growth oriented. We live by our core values: Responsible | Honest | Inclusive | Innovative. Our vision is to bring our employees and clients one step ahead. We are looking for Onshore Commissioning Manager Pnr: 23865 Job Description: Onshore coordination of offshore commissioning Act as the main commissioning coordination point onshore. Maintain continuous alignment with the Offshore Commissioning Manager and offshore commissioning leads. Coordinate actions and support requests originating from offshore. Ensure issues requiring onshore support are assigned to the correct function and followed through to closure. Escalate unresolved constraints that may affect commissioning progress, start-up or critical milestones. Planning and look-ahead Coordinate the onshore contribution to the commissioning plan. Maintain close alignment with offshore planning and Project Controls. Support development of daily, weekly and multi-week look-aheads. Identify upcoming requirements for engineering, vendors, ATS, materials and specialist resources. Ensure foreseeable offshore requirements are addressed proactively rather than reactively. Support evaluation of commissioning priorities where offshore constraints require resequencing. IOC coordination Act as the primary commissioning interface towards the IOC. Coordinate commissioning activities that can be supported or executed through IOC. Ensure the correct IOC competence is connected with the offshore commissioning teams. Coordinate remote technical support and troubleshooting. Facilitate direct collaboration between offshore personnel, IOC, Engineering and vendors. Identify opportunities to move work and technical problem-solving from offshore to IOC. Ensure effective communication routines between offshore and IOC. Engineering and technical support Coordinate technical queries and engineering support required by the offshore organisation. Ensure technical issues are routed to the appropriate discipline or technical authority. Follow up critical engineering actions affecting commissioning. Coordinate vendor and specialist involvement where required. Ensure offshore receives clear and timely technical responses. ATS and vendor coordination Maintain overview of upcoming offshore ATS/vendor requirements. Coordinate mobilisation and remote support according to the commissioning plan. Challenge requirements for offshore mobilisation where support can effectively be provided remotely through IOC. Ensure vendors are prepared ahead of scheduled activities. Coordinate changes in vendor priorities following changes in offshore execution sequence. Materials and logistics Coordinate with Supply Chain and Logistics on commissioning-critical materials and equipment. Maintain visibility of missing or urgent items affecting commissioning. Prioritise offshore shipment of commissioning-critical equipment and spares. Ensure material constraints are reflected in commissioning Qualifications: Relevant engineering degree or equivalent technical background Extensive commissioning experience from major oil & gas projects, preferably offshore Hook-Up & Commissioning Proven leadership of commissioning across multiple disciplines and interfaces Solid understanding of the completion process from MC to RFCC, RFOC, start-up and handover to Operations Experience with commissioning planning and look-ahead management Fluent in English and a scandinavian language. Experience with IOC or remote operations and support Experience with ATS/vendor coordination Familiarity with NCS requirements and client's completion processes Personal Traits: Proactive coordinator with strong ownership and follow-through Clear communicator who works well with both onshore and offshore teams Solution-oriented and able to prioritise under pressure Strong HSSE commitment Applications will be evaluated continuously Language: English Norwegian In Head Energy You Get: Permanent- or project employment with the best conditions.
